ImageDescription.value: Lt. Gen. Thomas Bostick, commanding general of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, traveled to Nome Aug.14 and met with Mayor Denise Michels and discussed the potential of an Arctic deep draft port. Shown here is Michels with Bostick’s traveling party underneath the famous burled arches where the Iditarod, a world-famous sled dog race, ends. From right to left is Amy Holmes, special assistant to the commanding general; Bruce Sexauer, chief of the Civil Works Branch; Pat Coullahan, chief of the Construction Division; Bostick; Michels; Col. Christopher Lestochi, district commander and Randy Bowker, acting chief of the Programs and Project Management Division.
